notes.title: Online Scoreboard back up!
notes.notes: Thanks to the work of my colleague, I'm happy to announce that the online scoreboard is functional once again. Enjoy seeing how well your solutions are once more!

notes.title: Game online score content temporarily disabled
notes.notes:
Hello all. Merry Christmas. 

If you have bought the game recently I do sincerely apologise for the recent crashes that make the game quite unplayable.

I have updated the game so it is playable once more, however online score comparison will not be available for awhile. I hope it will not be long but since it is dependent on a third party I cannot say when the issue will be fixed.

All the best and have a great New Year.

notes.title: Updated game to include more instructions
notes.notes:
Some players have informed us that the "Best Moves: and "Best Commands" were not clear, as well as the fact that for some levels the ideal solution for one of the achievements is not the same as the other.

Have now included explanations to help notify new players.

Still finding a way to notify players that all "Best" solutions are achieved by other players and not predetermined by us.

notes.title: Little Lost Robots is released!
notes.notes:
We hope you enjoy the game. 

It's very challenging. If you get stuck at any levels, or just want to solve levels with friends, come by our [url=https://discord.gg/4enNKSf]Discord[/url] channel and say hi.

Look forward to future updates to the game (more levels more mechanics) over the year. 

Peace!
